jobs.description:
• Our client is a well-established real estate services firm specializing in property management, building operations, and technical asset optimization.
• The organization supports a portfolio of professional and commercial real estate assets with a strong focus on service quality, efficiency, and long-term client relationships.

Jobomschrijving

• Coordinate technical maintenance, including tendering, planning, and execution
• Manage service providers (maintenance, cleaning, security, etc.)
• Ensure compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations
• Prepare and evaluate supplier offers, contracts, and performance
• Monitor works execution to ensure quality and adherence to standards
• Respond proactively to technical issues and operational incidents
• Develop and manage preventive maintenance programs and budgets
• Review and validate invoices from contractors and suppliers
• Optimize space utilization and coordinate internal relocations
• Organize facility services using dedicated FM tools and systems

• Background in engineering, facilities management, or technical operations
• Prior experience in building management or real estate services
• Excellent organizational and prioritization skills
• Strong communication and stakeholder coordination abilities
• Autonomous, proactive, and solution-driven mindset
• Resilience under pressure and ability to manage multiple priorities
• Familiarity with MS Office; knowledge of CAD tools is an advantage
• Fluent in English and French for professional interactions

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

A high-quality food company that delivers fresh products daily to hospitality clients and large-scale kitchens. The 300 employees work together day after day to make this possible. This market leader not only takes care of its customers, but also of its employees. Quality always comes first, which is why regular training is provided.

What does your working day look like as a Frozen Warehouse Worker?

 
• 
Restocking the frozen storage areas: you place incoming goods in the correct locations according to the warehouse layout

 
• 
You work with a handheld scanner that registers all movements

 
• 
You pick the correct goods and prepare them for transport, based on customer orders

 
• 
You perform accurate picking tasks by selecting the right products and efficiently preparing them for shipment

 
• 
You work according to a fixed schedule: Monday to Thursday from 12:00 PM to 9:30 PM, and Sunday from 6:00 PM to 10:00 PM. This gives you a fixed schedule every week

Who are we looking for as a Frozen Warehouse Worker?

 
• 
Physically fit: you can comfortably lift boxes weighing up to 20 kg

 
• 
You are comfortable working in a frozen environment and can work effectively in temperatures as low as -25°C while wearing appropriate protective clothing

 
• 
Experience in logistics or as a warehouse worker is a plus

 
• 
You pay close attention to quality

 
• 
You communicate good in Dutch or English to correctly follow up on order forms

What does the role involve?
 

 
• As an operator, you are responsible for the accurate execution of production processes.
 
• You precisely measure materials.
 
• You perform calculations and ensure everything runs according to plan.
 
• You work in an environment where quality and precision are key. 

Profile – What do we expect from you?
 

 
• Strong numerical skills and the ability to measure accurately.
 
• Good spatial awareness.
 
• Fluency in Dutch or very good proficiency in English.
 
• Flexibility: you work in day shifts, but are willing to switch to a two-shift system during peak workload.
 
• Careful and correct working method, with strong attention to detail.

As an Inventory Planner Natural Foods, you play a key role in ensuring the right stock is available at the right time. By working closely with production, suppliers, and sales, you help achieve an optimal balance between availability and costs. With your proactive approach, you contribute to a smooth supply chain and sustainable results.
 

Job description
 
 

• Managing and creating purchase orders for production plants, co‑manufacturers, and suppliers based on aligned planning with the demand planning teams. 

• Monitoring and analysing inventory levels to ensure optimal availability and service levels. 

• Proactively communicating about supply and expiry risks and contributing to the implementation of robust inventory management processes and best practices. 

• Aligning with internal production and supply chain teams to follow up on production plans and to identify and mitigate potential supply risks in a timely manner. 

• Monitoring production and transportation flows and ensuring accurate and up‑to‑date data in SAP. 

• Continuously improving and further automating the replenishment process, including optimisation of planning parameters. 

Profile
 

To be able to achieve the above and be successful in this role we believe you need to have:
 
 

• You hold a bachelor’s degree in a business‑related field. 

• You have at least one to two years of experience in supply chain planning, preferably in an FMCG or retail environment, and are familiar with working in a logistics‑ or transport‑oriented customer service setting; knowledge of SAP is a plus. 

• You have strong verbal and written communication skills in English and collaborate smoothly with various internal departments. 

• You work independently and proactively, with a strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy. 

• You are able to set priorities and work efficiently in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

Our client is a leading player in the event industry, specialized in the design and production of exhibition stand systems. The company is known for its innovative approach and high-quality products that are used worldwide at trade fairs, exhibitions, and events.

As an Assembly Worker, you will:

Working in a 2-shift system suits you

jobs.occupation: Huxley Associates Belgium - IT & Cyber Third Party Risk Assessor
jobs.description:
We are partnering with our client, a leading organisation in the banking sector, to recruit an experienced IT & Cyber Third Party Risk Assessor for their Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) team. In this strategic role, you will safeguard our client's operations by assessing and managing IT and cyber risks related to external vendors and intragroup providers, with a strong focus on cloud services and key technology partners.
Working model

• 50% onsite in Brussels

• 50% remote

 

If this aligns with your profile in information security and cyber risk, we would welcome a discussion about joining our client's team.

• Third-Party IT & Security Assessments - Conduct due diligence, evaluate controls and ensure suppliers meet security and regulatory expectations.

• Cloud Security (SaaS, IaaS, PaaS) - Assess cloud solutions and providers, reviewing architectures and risk mitigations.

• Vulnerability Management & Penetration Testing - Analyse reports, challenge remediation plans and track closure of critical findings.

• Application Security - Identify and assess application-related risks and ensure appropriate security measures.

• Risk & Control Frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, OWASP) - Apply recognised standards to structure assessments and recommendations.

• Contractual IT & Cyber Clauses - Review and negotiate security clauses with Procurement and Legal to embed robust protections.

• Audit & GRC Practices - Coordinate supplier audits, use GRC tools (e.g. ServiceNow) and support continuous monitoring.

• Stakeholder Management - Collaborate with cyber defense, security architects, continuity experts, Dpos, and business teams.

• Soft Skills - Strong analytical capabilities, clear communication, structured approach, negotiation skills, and ability to coach and influence across our client's team.

• Languages - French and English are mandatory Dutch is a plus.

Our client is a leading international industrial group with operations across multiple continents and an ambitious growth strategy driven by innovation and strategic investments.

To strengthen its specialist M&A Legal team, the organisation is looking to appoint a Senior Legal Counsel based in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As Senior Legal Counsel - M&A, you will act as lead legal adviser on high-profile international transactions.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Leading the legal execution of domestic and international acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures and strategic investments.
• Managing complex legal due diligence exercises and coordinating specialist legal input across multiple jurisdictions.
• Drafting, reviewing and negotiating transaction documentation, including share purchase agreements, joint venture agreements, transition service agreements, NDAs and other ancillary documents.
• Advising on transaction structuring and identifying pragmatic solutions to legal and commercial risks.
• Partnering with internal stakeholders across Corporate Strategy, M&A, Finance, Treasury, Tax, HR, IT and Compliance throughout the deal lifecycle.
• Managing signing, closing and post-closing processes.
• Supporting integrations, carve-outs and corporate reorganisations following completed transactions.
• Coordinating and managing external legal counsel internationally while maintaining ownership of transaction execution.
• Advising senior management on strategic legal considerations impacting investment decisions.
• Contributing to the continuous development of the company's M&A legal function and best practices.

• Belgian Master's degree in Law.
• Approximately 8+ years of post-qualification experience in Corporate/M&A law.
• Experience gained within a leading international law firm and/or a sophisticated international in-house legal environment.
• Demonstrated experience leading complex domestic and cross-border M&A transactions.
• Excellent drafting, negotiation and project management skills.
• Strong commercial judgement and ability to translate legal complexity into practical business advice.
• Confident communicator with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
• Fluent in English. French and/or Dutch are considered strong assets.

About the Role
 

We are looking for a versatile and reliable Administrative & Finance Support Officer to join our Finance & Administration team.
 

This is not a role for an accounting specialist, nor are we searching for the next CFO of the group. Instead, we are looking for a well-organized administrative professional who is comfortable with numbers, has a practical mindset, and enjoys bringing structure and order to daily operations.
 

Key Responsibilities
 
 
 
• Processing and monitoring bank statements 
 
• Managing and reviewing expense reports 
 
• Verifying and following up on supplier invoices 
 
• Updating Excel files and internal databases 
 
• Document management and filing 
 
• Providing general administrative support to the Finance & Administration department 
 
• Contributing to the continuous improvement of administrative processes 

Your Profile
 
 
 
• Previous experience in an administrative, back-office, or financial support role 
 
• Experience working with an ERP system or integrated business software is a strong asset 
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft 365, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Teams 
 
• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills 
 
• Reliable and trustworthy professional attitude 
 
• Ability to work independently 
 
• Practical mindset and willingness to build a long-term career within the company 
 

We also appreciate people who ask questions when they don't know something rather than allowing the problem to mature quietly in their inbox.
 

 
 

Language Skills
 
 
 
• Good professional command of French and/or Dutch 
 
• Practical knowledge of English, allowing you to communicate by email, phone, and Microsoft Teams in a professional environment 
 
• Willingness to further develop your English skills as part of the role 
 

Being trilingual is certainly an advantage, but we are not necessarily looking for a simultaneous interpreter for the European Commission.

To support continued growth, Our client are seeking an experienced Purchasing Manager to lead procurement activities, supplier strategy, and quality oversight across multiple European operations while managing a purchasing and quality team.

A successful Strategic Purchasing Manager should have:

• Proven people management experience

• Experience negotiating contracts and driving savings initiatives

• Fluent in English, Dutch and French
• Strong communication, leadership and stakeholder management skills
• Results-driven, organised and resilient mindset

An SME in the Waasland region known for the production, purchase, and sale of pallets.

Jobomschrijving

Job Description:
Are you seeking a new challenge where you can utilize your physical strength and precision? Our client, a renowned company in pallet production, is looking for a Robot Operator for Pallet Production.

As a Robot Operator for Pallet Production, you will be responsible for operating the production robot. Your role includes preparing the workstation: arranging planks and components on the worktable, which are then automatically assembled by the robot. The job requires physical effort, is repetitive in nature, and takes place in a noisy environment. Therefore, we are looking for someone who is up for the challenge.

Your tasks include:
	
• Preparing and placing planks and components on the worktable.	
• Operating and monitoring the production robot.	
• Ensuring a safe and efficient work environment.	
• Collaborating with the team to ensure smooth production processes.

Profile Description
What are we looking for?

We are seeking an energetic and physically strong individual who meets the following requirements:
	
• You are physically fit and comfortable with repetitive tasks.	
• You are flexible: until September, you will work in a day shift, and afterward in a two-shift system (morning and afternoon shifts).	
• You can communicate in Dutch or English to collaborate effectively with the team.	
• You work accurately and have attention to detail.	
• You have prior experience in a production environment.

jobs.occupation: Senior Business Analyst / Project Manager IT
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international player operating in the retail and distribution sector, with a strong presence in multiple markets. The company provides a wide range of products and services to both professional and private customers, supported by an extensive network and a strong focus on customer experience.

As part of the IT organization, you will play a key role in analyzing, optimizing, and transforming business processes across Supply Chain and Finance domains. Acting as a strategic business partner, you will work closely with business stakeholders to understand operational challenges, identify improvement opportunities, and translate business needs into sustainable IT solutions.

Jobomschrijving

• Analyze end-to-end business processes, particularly within Supply Chain and Finance, and identify opportunities for optimization and efficiency gains.
• Partner with business stakeholders to understand challenges, define requirements, and design improved processes.
• Translate business needs into pragmatic, scalable, and sustainable SAP-based solutions.
• Challenge business requirements by proposing alternatives aligned with industry best practices and standard solutions.
• Lead or contribute to functional design activities, testing phases, implementation projects, and change initiatives.
• Coordinate collaboration between business teams, IT teams, SAP experts, and external partners to ensure successful project delivery.
• Ensure consistency and integration across SAP modules and business processes.
• Support issue resolution by providing functional expertise and a strong understanding of business impacts.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to the evolution of the application landscape.
• Participate in roadmap definition and transformation programs, from analysis through implementation.
• Take ownership of projects or workstreams, ensuring effective planning, stakeholder alignment, and delivery.

• 5 to 10 years of experience in a Senior Business Analyst, SAP Consultant, SAP Functional Analyst, or similar role.
• Proven experience working on SAP-related projects, with strong knowledge of Supply Chain and/or Finance processes.
• Good understanding of end-to-end business processes, ideally within a retail, distribution, or complex operational environment.
• Ability to quickly understand business challenges and translate them into effective solutions.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to structure complex topics and provide clear recommendations.
• Experience managing projects, coordinating stakeholders, and driving delivery is a strong asset.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interact confidently with both business and technical audiences.
• Pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset with a strong focus on business value and results.
• Proactive, autonomous, and comfortable working in a dynamic and evolving environment.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French is considered an advantage.
• Open-minded, collaborative, and motivated by change and continuous improvement.

A European industrial group operating in multiple countries is reinforcing its Group Finance structure and is hiring a Consolidation & Group Reporting Manager (or Expert).

The group works with complex operations, numerous entities and a strong international footprint, requiring robust reporting frameworks and high-quality consolidated financials.

Their offices are located in Walloon Brabant.

Jobomschrijving

You will lead the consolidation and reporting function, oversee IFRS compliance and safeguard the accuracy, consistency and timeliness of group accounts. As a key advisor to senior finance leadership, you will drive harmonisation of accounting practices and continuous improvement of the consolidation environment.

Key Responsibilities :

• Steer the monthly, quarterly and annual consolidation under IFRS
• Ensure quality and completeness of consolidated accounts (eliminations, minority interests, acquisitions/divestments…)
• Lead the preparation of the group's statutory financial statements and quarterly reporting
• Act as main point of contact for external auditors
• Participate to the migration to a new consolidation system (currently HFM)
• Develop reporting structures, dashboards and closing-process improvements
• Support M&A activities (PPA, integration, system setup)
• Collaborate closely with FP&A, treasury and local accounting teams
• Possibility to manage one consolidation analyst (depending on experience).

• Master's degree in Finance/Accounting; professional qualification (CPA, ACCA…) is an asset
• 6-12 years of experience in Consolidation within an international context
• Strong IFRS expertise and ability to handle complex accounting topics
• Rigorous, analytical and comfortable with tight deadlines
• Excellent communication with the ability to influence stakeholders across countries
• Fluent in English (French is a plus).

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Company located in Roeselare

This Belgian manufacturer of dry powder mixtures for the construction industry (mortars, adhesives, plasters, etc.), located in the Port of Antwerp, is looking to strengthen its current team with a motivated OPERATOR.

As an OPERATOR, you will be responsible for all operational tasks required during your shift for production and loading activities. You will play a crucial role in the production process and will be widely deployable across various production lines, from mixing processes to bagging.

Your responsibilities as an OPERATOR* will include:

• Preparing, weighing and accurately dosing raw materials and additives for mixing processes, particularly liquids.
• Monitoring and operating mixing and filling machines, such as dissolvers, mixing tanks and filling equipment.
• Operating, converting and setting up bagging machines.
• Setting up and loading packaging materials (e.g. film) onto the machines.
• Carrying out process checks and visual inspections of the finished product, such as checking viscosity and colour consistency.
• Replacing simple mechanical components on the production lines.
• Processing residual product and cleaning the factory, including cleaning mixing equipment and pipelines.
• Assisting drivers during loading operations.
• Carrying out internal transport and logistical activities using a forklift and/or reach truck.

REF:MEC1

Experience & Profile

• You have proven relevant work experience as an OPERATOR in a production environment.
• Experience with mixing, dispersing or filling liquids, or operating bagging and packaging machines, is preferred.
• A valid forklift and/or reach truck certificate is a major advantage.
• You are familiar with terminology and techniques used in the mixing industry, such as batch production, dosing and basic quality control
• You have a technical aptitude and a strong problem-solving mindset.
• You are communicative and have a good command of Dutch or English
